description: This file defines a PHP trait named EncryptionHelperTrait used within the OrangeHRM project. The trait provides utility methods related to cryptography, including retrieving a Cryptographer instance and checking if encryption is enabled. It interacts with external classes KeyHandler and Cryptographer, and is part of the OrangeHRM Core Utility namespace.

methods.name: getCryptographer
methods.description: Retrieves a singleton Cryptographer instance if key exists; initializes it if necessary.

methods.name: encryptionEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether encryption is enabled by verifying if a Cryptographer instance is available.
